messages.content: You can call search_flights to find flights matching the user's needs.
Find me a direct flight from Beijing to San Francisco next Monday, economy class, under $1500.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to find a direct flight from Beijing (PEK) to San Francisco (SFO) next Monday in economy class under $15,000. Let me use the search_flights function.

I need:
- from_airport: PEK (Beijing Capital International Airport)
- to_airport: SFO (San Francisco International Airport)
- depart_date: next Monday - I need to determine what date next Monday is. Today is Saturday, November 9, 2024, so next Monday would be November 11, 2024.
- cabin_class: economy
- direct_only: true (user specifically asked for direct flights)
- max_price_usd: 15000

Let me make this call.
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="search_flights">
<parameter name="from_airport">PEK</parameter>
<parameter name="to_airport">SFO</parameter>
<parameter name="depart_date">2024-11-11</parameter>
<parameter name="max_price_usd">15000</parameter>
<parameter name="cabin_class">economy</parameter>
<parameter name="direct_only">true</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
